prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose How to Build Your Pet", "Upload photos for custom AI generation or choose a quick pre-built style template."]
1: ["Generating Your Desktop Companion", "We are preparing your pet animations and desktop interactions."]
2: ["Meet Your Desktop Pet!", "Try moving your pet around and clicking to open the quick desktop interaction menu.", "Try Desktop Controls"]
3: []
4: ["Sign in with your primary email to ensure your pet is saved safely to your cloud account.", "Cloud Save Enabled: Syncs your pet and progress automatically."]
5: ["Choose Your Pet Companion Journey", "Complete onboarding today to unlock an exclusive Starter Badge for your pet!", "Early Adopter Perk"]
6: ["You can minimize this window. We will send a notification when your pet lands on your desktop!", "Notify Me When Ready"]
7: ["Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, feed, or change settings. Access the tray icon for quick options."]
8: ["For best results, upload clear, well-lit photos with a single pet centered in the image.", "Supported formats: JPG, PNG. Clear lighting ensures accurate rendering."]
9: ["How Would You Like to Start?", "Select standard companion for immediate setup or custom generation for a personalized pet."]

verdicts.problem: Creates urgency and offers exclusive perks/gifts for completing onboarding today.
